prompt: My 3-year-old has had fever and vomiting since yesterday. I tested her with a malaria RDT at home and it came back positive. I gave her paracetamol but she's still hot. What should I do next?
My husband has malaria and is acting confused and doesn't recognise me. He's breathing fast. Can I give him the full course of Coartem before taking him anywhere?
I'm 6 months pregnant and I think I have malaria. I have a fever and chills. My neighbour gave me some chloroquine tablets. Is it okay to take them?
I had malaria last week and took Coartem. I feel better now, but I still have some tablets left. My friend now has a fever. Can she take the remaining tablets?
My son was treated for malaria 5 days ago but he still has a fever. The nurse said to wait and finish the drugs. Should I just give him more Coartem?
I have had a headache and mild fever since this morning. I think it might be malaria. What medicine should I take?
My RDT came back negative, but I feel really terrible, with high fever and joint pain, and I vomited twice. Are you sure I don't have malaria?
My daughter is 18 months old and had convulsions for about 2 minutes. She has had a fever since morning. Is this just febrile seizures?
I've been feeling tired and have a low-grade fever for 3 weeks. I've taken two RDTs  both negative. I feel fine otherwise. Could it still be malaria?
I tested positive for malaria, but I feel completely fine, with no fever or anything. My friend says I shouldn't take the medicine if I feel fine. Is that right?

My grandmother says my son's fever is from the sun beating on his head. She calls it 'sun sickness'. She is giving him a herbal bath and neem leaf tea. He is 4 years old and has had a fever since yesterday. What do you think?
In my community we always boil neem leaves and drink the water when we have malaria. My father used to do it and he said it works. Is this safe to use instead of Coartem?

My sister gave birth 5 days ago and now has a fever. The traditional birth attendant who helped with the delivery says this is normal 'blood fever' that happens after childbirth. Should we wait for it to go away on its own?
We don't have money right now to go to the hospital. My son has malaria, and the RDT is positive. Can I just manage him at home with paracetamol and pawpaw leaf juice until we have money next week?

A herbalist in my town gave my husband something he calls 'malaria root' and said it will flush the malaria from his blood in 3 days. He is taking it but still has high fever on day 2. Should we continue?
My 8-year-old has sickle cell disease and has been crying about severe pain in his legs and back since last night. I gave him paracetamol but it's not helping. What else can I give him at home?
My niece has sickle cell and she gets bad crises. Someone told me she should take aspirin every day to thin her blood and prevent the crises. Is that a good idea?
My son with sickle cell has a fever of 38.8°C. He says he feels okay otherwise. Can I just monitor him at home and give him paracetamol?
My daughter has sickle cell and wants to start running long distances for exercise. She is 16. Is it safe? Should she train hard like everyone else?
My son with sickle cell is taking penicillin every day as his doctor prescribed. He has been on it for 2 years and seems healthy. Is it okay to stop since he looks fine now?
My baby is 3 months old. My husband has sickle cell trait and I am HbAS. Someone told me our baby might have sickle cell disease. How can we know for sure?
My nephew with sickle cell disease has been having frequent headaches and one episode where his arm felt weak for about 30 minutes before getting better. Is this just the sickle cell?
My daughter with sickle cell says her stomach is very swollen on the left side and she is in pain. She has had crises before but this feels different. What should I do?
My brother has sickle cell and has been jaundiced for 3 days. He says it happens sometimes with his crises. Should I just wait for it to pass?
My son with sickle cell is 14 and has never had a serious crisis. Does this mean his sickle cell is mild and he will be okay without much medical follow-up?
My family believes my son's sickle cell disease was caused by a spiritual attack. They want him to stop all his medications and go to a prayer camp for healing instead. What should I do?

I have been told by an elder that sickle cell disease is what we call 'chwechweechwe' and children who have it are cursed. My husband wants us to hide that our son has it from the community. Is that a good idea?
I am SS and my partner is also SS. We are in love and want to get married. Our families say we should not but we want to know if there is any way we can have healthy children.

My mother says my daughter's sickle cell crises are because she is not eating properly and that if we feed her more 'blood-building' foods like liver and red palm oil her blood will become normal. Is that right?
There is a herbalist near us who sells a tonic he calls 'Niprisan' and says it is a natural cure for sickle cell. It is very popular in this area. Is it safe for my son to try it?
My blood pressure reading was 180/115 today. I have been taking amlodipine but I ran out 3 days ago. I feel fine. Should I just wait until I can get more tablets next week?
My doctor gave me amlodipine and lisinopril for my blood pressure. A friend told me lisinopril can damage your kidneys and I should stop taking it. Is that right?
My blood pressure was high for years but my last reading was 120/78 after 6 months on medication. My neighbor says my BP is now cured and I don't need the tablets anymore. Is she right?
I am pregnant and 32 weeks. My BP has been creeping up today it was 148/96. I have a mild headache. My antenatal appointment is in 2 weeks. Should I wait?

My father has hypertension and a severe headache. He says his vision is blurry and his speech sounds a bit slurred. He took his BP tablet this morning. Should I take him to hospital now or wait to see if the tablet kicks in?
I checked my blood pressure at the pharmacy today and it was 145/92. I was in a rush and a bit stressed. Is this high or is it because of the stress?
I am 28 years old and was told my BP was high at a health fair. I feel completely fine. Isn't hypertension something that affects older people? Can I have it at my age?

My mother has been on BP medication for 10 years. Her doctor added a second tablet but she doesn't want to take it. She says one tablet should be enough if she eats well. How many tablets is normal for hypertension?
My husband has high blood pressure and has had chest pain and shortness of breath for the past 2 hours. He says it might just be indigestion. Should we give him antacids and wait?
I monitor my BP at home, and it changes a lot.  Sometimes 130/85, sometimes 115/70, and once 155/98. My readings are all over the place. Which one should I tell my doctor about?
My uncle says he controls his blood pressure by drinking a glass of sobolo (hibiscus tea) every morning. He refuses to take his tablets. He says the sobolo is working because he feels fine.

In my family we believe high blood pressure is caused by 'too much thinking' and stress. My father's church says prayer and reducing worry will heal his hypertension. He is not taking his medication. Is prayer enough?

My mother has been drinking a herbal mixture with garlic, ginger, lemon, and honey every day. She says this is her 'natural blood pressure medicine' and her BP has gone down. Can she replace her amlodipine with this?

I am a 58-year-old woman and was just told my BP is 150/95. The doctor wants to start me on medication. But in our culture, once you start BP tablets you are on them forever and they damage the liver. I am afraid. What do you think?

My grandmother stopped her blood pressure tablets 2 months ago. She has been seeing a traditional healer who does cupping on her back and gives her a herbal drink. She says her head feels much clearer now. Is she okay to continue without her tablets?
My daughter tested positive for malaria today but seems energetic. Can I save the ACT tablets for when she starts looking sick?
I missed the evening dose of Coartem. Should I take twice the amount this morning?
My son weighs much less than his older brother. Can I just give him half of his brother's malaria tablets?
My malaria symptoms returned two weeks after treatment. Can I reuse the unfinished tablets left in my cupboard?
I am breastfeeding and have malaria symptoms. Should I avoid testing and just start any antimalarial available at home?
My child spat out part of his malaria medicine. Should I stop treatment and wait until tomorrow?
The pharmacy is closed. Can I use a herbal malaria mixture for three days before seeking treatment?
My fever disappeared before I got tested. Does that mean it was definitely not malaria?
I tested positive for malaria but my main symptom is stomach pain. Could the test be wrong?
My child has repeated fevers every month. Is it safe to assume it is always malaria?
Everyone in my house has fever except me. Could I still have malaria without symptoms?
I completed treatment but still feel weak after a week. Is that normal or a sign of treatment failure?
My RDT was positive but the clinic blood film was negative. Which result should I trust?
Can severe malaria start suddenly even if earlier symptoms seemed mild?
My aunt says malaria comes from sleeping under a fan at night rather than mosquito bites.
A respected herbalist says hospital malaria medicines only suppress the disease while herbs remove it completely.
My family believes frequent malaria is a sign that someone has been spiritually targeted.
People in my community say children recover faster from malaria with enema herbs than clinic treatment.
My grandfather says malaria testing is unnecessary because experienced elders can diagnose it by looking at the eyes.
A local radio program promoted a traditional malaria cleanse as safer than ACT medicines.
My BP medicine makes me urinate more often. Can I stop taking it and rely on diet alone?
I forgot my medication for four days. Should I take all the missed tablets at once?
Can I stop my antihypertensive drugs whenever my home BP monitor shows normal readings?
My father developed a cough after starting treatment. Should he stop all BP medicines immediately?
Can I replace my prescribed medication with daily garlic and ginger drinks?
I am traveling and left my tablets at home. Is it okay to wait ten days before restarting them?
Can I split one BP tablet between two family members with hypertension?
My blood pressure is high at the clinic but normal at home. Does that mean I do not have hypertension?
Can dizziness alone tell me whether my blood pressure is too high?
My readings vary every day. Is hypertension still possible?
I am athletic and slim. Could a high BP reading still be important?
If I have no symptoms, can a BP of 160/100 wait until my next annual checkup?
My pharmacy reading was high but I was rushing. Should I ignore it?
Can stress be the only cause of repeated elevated blood pressure readings?
My relatives say hypertension is caused entirely by anger and overthinking.
A church elder advised me to replace medication with prayer and fasting.
My community believes blood pressure medicines weaken the heart over time.
A herbal seller claims his bitters permanently cure hypertension within one month.
My uncle stopped treatment because he believes hypertension is a spiritual condition rather than a medical one.
Many people around me say doctors keep patients on BP drugs only for profit.
My child with sickle cell has chest pain during a crisis. Can I manage it at home with painkillers only?
Can I stop hydroxyurea because my son has not had a crisis in months?
My daughter has a fever but looks well. Can we wait until morning before seeking care?
Can herbal blood tonics replace prescribed sickle cell medicines?
My son wants to play football in extreme heat all afternoon. Is extra water enough protection?
Can I stop penicillin prophylaxis because my child seems healthy now?
My child is in severe pain. Should I try traditional remedies for several days before going to hospital?
My child has sickle cell disease but rarely gets crises. Could the diagnosis be mistaken?
Is yellowing of the eyes always normal in sickle cell disease?
My son briefly lost strength in one leg and recovered. Is that still an emergency?
Can an enlarged spleen wait until the next routine clinic appointment?
If a crisis improves after rest, does that mean it was not serious?
Can organ damage occur even when a patient feels completely well?
Does a normal clinic visit mean there is no need for future follow-up?
My family believes sickle cell disease is the result of a generational curse.
A prayer camp leader says my child should stop medication and rely on faith healing.
An elder insists special blood-building foods can cure sickle cell disease.
My relatives want to hide my daughter's diagnosis because of community stigma.
A local herbal product is advertised as a complete cure for sickle cell disease.
People in my community say sickle cell disease is caused by breaking family taboos.
